title: Add combined security and architecture drift guardrails
description:
Problem: complexity and security posture can drift independently unless guardrails monitor both dimensions together.

Desired outcome: integrated checks that detect architectural monolith re-growth and security posture regressions early.

Scope:
- In scope: drift checks/reports for hotspot growth, boundary violations, and key security posture signals.
- Out of scope: heavyweight enterprise policy tooling.

Acceptance criteria:
- Guardrail output reports both architecture and security drift indicators.
- Report is actionable and linked to owning tasks/sprints.
- Initial mode can be warning-only with a clear path to enforcement.

Validation:
- Demonstrate guardrail output on current state and post-refactor state.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Stretch convergence item created for sustained mixed-track governance.
